signature: internal fixed portable nonvariadic; params/results/noundef exactly rows; abiNone; descriptor per-row returned-target namespace, not source C service signature

policies.all: Validate signature/capability/handle generation and all buffer guards before host effect; guest pointers never become unchecked host pointers. Zero-length spans need no dereference. Host errors convert explicitly; status0 success else positive portable errno; failure value0. Preserve structured native cause in runtime diagnostics, not guest errno alias. No runtime lock across host/guest callbacks. One operation ticket owns effect/result publication; cancellation only before irreversible effect, thereafter defer or publish a successful partial transfer. Resume never repeats effect.
policies.memory: Map returns zero-defined bytes with fresh object/generation; align positive power2, size>0, permissions R1/W2 only. Protect/unmap close admission and drain guard pins of every alias before changing mapping. No executable guest-data permission. Failed mutation leaves mapping unchanged.
policies.file: Paths counted strict UTF8, no NUL, length1..4096B; interpret selected guest personality namespace, never native path spelling by default. Handles process-owned generation checked, refcounts/dup share one open description/offset. Lock offset around one I/O ticket; partial read/write succeeds with exact byte count, at most65536B per call. EOF succeeds0. Failure after any bytes is success/count, native cause retained for next call. Close marks unusable before external close; no retry/reuse of same handle.
policies.file_control: All metadata/output structures are canonical little-endian service layouts, never host stat/dirent/timespec. Mutations commit once; read-only failures leave destination unchanged. Seek checked signed arithmetic no wrap, negative final offset EINVAL; regular file offsets independent of guest pointers. read_dir yields one complete entry or EOF0; insufficient nonzero capacity ERANGE and cursor unchanged; capacity0 peeks required bytes. read_link likewise capacity0 queries needed length, else whole result or ERANGE.
policies.clock: IDs0 monotonic,1 UTC Unix epoch (POSIX seconds, leap seconds excluded),2 process CPU,3 thread CPU. clock.read/resolution write time16; monotonic/CPU seconds nonnegative. clock.now converts checked seconds*10^9+nsec to u64 ns, overflow EOVERFLOW. sleep uses relative monotonic ns, UINT64_MAX not accepted; interruption EINTR writes exact remaining ns. Timezone uses immutable configured TZif artifact digest, not ambient host default; UTC profile always available.
policies.entropy: Fill entire <=1048576B destination atomically on successful host entropy; resource/error/cancel before copyout leaves unchanged. No PRNG fallback and no promise of deterministic bytes.
policies.thread: Spawn exact portable u64(data_ptr) token and arg in same process, publish handle only after worker reservation; TLS/fenv rounding+flags initially default, errno0, diagnostic policy inherited explicitly. Parallel workers permitted and required runtime capability. Join returns after target TLS/cleanup; self EDEADLK, concurrent secondjoin EINVAL, detached EINVAL; successful join consumes handle. Yield publishes exact next frontier. Detach consumes join right, not execution ownership.
policies.sync: wait32 address4B aligned in canonical shared atomic backing; compare and queue registration one transaction preventing lost wakeup. Return EAGAIN mismatch, ETIMEDOUT deadline, EINTR guest signal; spurious success allowed, caller loops. timeout u64ns0 poll,MAX infinite. wake selects oldest registration by monotonic wait ticket; count0 wakes0. No whole scheduler lock retained while blocking.
policies.process: All child arguments/environment copied from canonical spawn_spec before publication; returned handle identifies guest process. clone snapshot invokes coordinated all-worker safepoint, retains only caller thread in child, coherent shared/private/COW backing and handle inheritance, resets child pending signals/tickets; unexportable native/host resource EBUSY before publication. No direct host fork under runtime locks. wait consumes exited child handle only after cleanup; exit clean,quick,immediate modes use specified termination transaction; abort terminates without guest cleanup. Spawn never invokes ambient shell.
policies.module: Open exact verified artifact digest and explicit dependency deployment, no filesystem enumeration. Resolve all SCC/type/ABI/capabilities and personality/ISA before publication; constructors may callback outside locks. Close BUSY for own frame/callback/TLS/object/exception/native/code leases; close admission then drain others, reverse successful init finalization. symbol resolves exported namespace/name and actual admitted signature, never private ID equality.
policies.environment: Guest process environment protected by guest lock, counted UTF8 names/values no NUL; name nonempty no equals. get capacity0 returns required bytes excludingNUL, else complete value or ERANGE unchanged; absent ENOENT. set/unset snapshot atomically, never mutate host process environment. cwd is guest namespace state; locale baseline C only, other names ENOENT; ctype/formatting reside in guest libc.
policies.signal: Guest signals only: delivery queued to logical thread and observed at admitted safepoints, never unwind Rust or run arbitrary guest code in host async signal handler. set accepts default0/ignore1 or exact void(i32) code token with lease; signal numbers use selected personality table and admission. mask is canonical128B little-bitset with unavailable bits rejected; SIGKILL/SIGSTOP cannot be blocked on Linux/Darwin. raise synchronously queues current logical thread; fatal default invokes termination protocol. Host faults are runtime trap records, not inferred signal handlers.
